## Key context / drift
- PROPOSED is NOT a DB review_status enum. P03.2 cascade is a PURE library (MatchResult,
  disposition="auto_write"); connectors not DB-wired. => P05.1 = library code + versioned data +
  CLI + tests, mirroring P03.2. Review-queue persistence/UI is P05.2 (out of scope). "PROPOSED" is
  a disposition value ("review"), never auto_write.
- ADR drift: spec Appendix F logical "ADR-016 = Splink"; repo ADR-016 already = dagster. Repo ADRs
  to ADR-028 => new = ADR-029 (Splink 4 for probabilistic ER).
- splink4 + duckdb NOT yet deps; add to resolution/pyproject.toml + uv.lock.
- Integrate: cascade.py, normalize.py, public_id.py (merge/split), temporal_identity.py.
- Data config via @cache + tomllib + importlib.resources.

## PLAN (Phase 1) — new modules in resolution/src/resolution/
- probabilistic.py: Splink4/DuckDB matcher (SIG-IDENT-021/024/025) + tiers 4/5 (SIG-IDENT-020).
  Fully-specified m/u model (deterministic, no EM). predict() -> match_weight + per-comparison
  bf_*/gamma_* decomposition. Tier 4 (>= review_threshold), tier 5 (weak band), tier 6 (< discard,
  NO per-pair record). disposition="review" (PROPOSED) always. Trigram: candidate-search only,
  never a decision score (guard/test).
- blocking.py: sized blocking (SIG-IDENT-023). size a rule (pair count), reject > ceiling; prohibit
  suffix-alone / state-alone. Trigram MAY generate candidates (SIG-IDENT-024).
- gold_set.py: (SIG-IDENT-027) stratified blocked-pair sampling across weight bands; 3-value label
  vocab (match/non_match/not_enough_information); written adjudication rules (data); double
  adjudication + Cohen's kappa; frozen holdout; versioned + per-label provenance.
- quality_gates.py: (SIG-IDENT-028/029) pairwise P/R/F1 at each tier boundary; B-cubed cluster P/R
  on holdout; auto-write demotion when holdout precision < published threshold; cluster-shape alerts
  (oversized PD/sheriff; single-bridge join of substantial components).
- er_run.py: (SIG-RECON-001/002) ERRun record (mirrors evidence.IngestRun): ruleset/resolver/model
  versions, code_commit, params, status, distinct stage normalize()->load(); ERQualityReport bundles
  gates; recluster() re-runnable -> NEW same_as (temporal_identity.OrganizationRelation) w/ NEW
  ruleset version, routes cluster changes through public_id.PublicIdRegistry merge/split
  (SIG-IDENT-032); rollback path. No DB wiring (mirrors P03.2/ADR-028 "layers that exist today").
- cascade.py: additive resolve_cascade()/probabilistic entrypoint composing tiers 0-3 + 4-5; keep
  resolve() unchanged (back-compat).
- cli.py: add subcommands er-match, block-size (demonstrable, SIG-ENG-013).
- data/: splink_model.toml, blocking_rules.toml, gold_set_rules.toml, quality_gates.toml (versioned).
- pyproject mypy override for splink/duckdb/pandas/igraph missing stubs.

## TEST MATRIX (tests/resolution/)
- test_probabilistic.py: AC1 tiers4/5 PROPOSED only; AC2 tier+evidence+weight+decomposition; tier6 no
  record; SIG-IDENT-024 trigram not a decision score; SIG-IDENT-021 Splink is the matcher.
- test_blocking.py: AC5 sizing+oversized rejection; suffix-alone/state-alone prohibited; trigram
  candidate-gen allowed.
- test_gold_set.py: stratified across bands; kappa; 3-value vocab; frozen holdout; per-label
  provenance; versioned.
- test_quality_gates.py: P/R/F1 at boundaries; B-cubed; AC3 demotion on precision breach; AC4
  cluster-shape alerts (seeded oversized + single-bridge).
- test_er_run.py: run record shape; AC re-run -> new same_as new ruleset version, no destruction;
  rollback; SIG-IDENT-032 stability wired.
